description: This file defines the ModelTreeCondition class, which models a <condition> element within a widget tree configuration. It includes a constructor that creates a ModelCondition based on an XML DOM Element, and a getter method to retrieve this condition.

classes.name: ModelTreeCondition
classes.description: Represents a condition element in a widget model tree, encapsulating a ModelCondition instance.

methods.name: ModelTreeCondition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ModelTreeCondition with a ModelTree and an XML Element representing the condition.
